title: Ing Baryu keng Pampang ning Pamanyubuk
intro: akit me ing sarili mu keng metung a baryu keng pampang, nung nukarin ing siwala da reng alun mipagkalub la kareng bulong da reng taung mekalingwan. dininan da lang utus ning pamagpainawa, pero ing karelang kasakiman meging sangkan ning parusa na angga ngeni sasabyan da keng tahimik a tono. Malyari meng abalu nung ninu la?
clues: Menuknangan kami king lele ning pampang at dininan da kaming utus a magselebra king metung a aldo ning kapaynawan.
King aldong ita, dakal la reng asan a daratang kekami, pero bawal da kaming kuanan.
Deng aliwa kekami migbabala la laban keng pamaglabag, pero deng aliwa migkunsabu la para manila.
Lebagan mi ya ing sagradung utus at dinan ming mabayat a parusa ing sarili mi.
Ing kekaming parusa metung yang pamagbayu na likuan na kaming mesira at makarine.
Meging unggoy kami, tanda para kareng sablang datang kaybat.

arabic: وَسْـَٔلْهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَتْ حَاضِرَةَ ٱلْبَحْرِ إِذْ يَعْدُونَ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًۭا وَيَوْمَ لَا يَسْبِتُونَ ۙ لَا تَأْتِيهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَبْلُوهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient. (7:163)
